name: liquilens-evidence-carrier
description: Offline, read-only verification and rights-bounded projection of local evidence carrier JSON.
long_description: Verifies carrier identity, clocks, rights, and authority boundaries before producing transport-specific projections. It makes no network requests and cannot recommend, rate credit, or execute trades.

tools.name: verify_carrier
tools.description: Verify identity, clocks, rights and export disposition for one local carrier JSON file.

tools.name: project_carrier
tools.description: Project one verified carrier through an existing rights-aware transport adapter.

evidence_root.title: Evidence directory
evidence_root.description: Directory containing carrier JSON files this read-only server may inspect.
